svg.title: BC policy training with frozen RoboJEPA consequence supervision
svg.desc: Observation history, robot state, and instruction enter a trainable BC policy, which predicts ten seven-value actions. The first four proposed and recorded actions are passed through the same frozen RoboJEPA conditioned on the same current images. Their predicted future features are compared with an anchored L1 loss; the recorded-action reference has stop gradient. Native BC negative log likelihood supervises all ten recorded actions. The combined loss updates only the BC policy.
svg.text: Training the policy from actions and their predicted consequences
